jade: quick triage sync — 55 open tickets, 6 P1s (up ~15% vs yesterday). Main pain: embeddings failing in eu-west (partial), a couple of duplicate billing charges flagged, and webhook timeouts for Dedicated customers. Rolling list below.
tom: can we get a quick breakdown of the 6 P1s?
jade: sure — short list: 2 infra (GPU nodes flapping), 2 model-regression (tokenizer mismatch causing truncation), 1 billing, 1 customer-config (VPC peering misconfig). I'll paste ticket IDs in a sec.
anita: for the billing one — is that the same pattern as last week (double-charges on plan-change)?
jade: yes same pattern, looks like the state machine didn't dedupe a retry. I've flagged payments team and added a temporary macro.
rory: who is on rotation for support-oncall tonight? need someone to take the billing P1 if it escalates.
jade: @rory you're primary tonight, @tom backup. I'll hand off at 18:30 PST. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-45 — eu-west embeddings degradation. Auto-ticket linked: TKT-7382. (severity: P1)
tom: thanks. can infra share the quick mitigation steps we told customers earlier so CS has a copy?
anita: adding an interim macro for CS copy — feel free to reuse and tweak. Suggest short TTL and escalation note.
anita: ```
Macro: EU-Embeddings-Degraded
Title: Temporary embeddings degradation in eu-west
Body:
Hi — we're seeing temporary degraded embedding generation in our eu-west region. Engineers are investigating (INC-2026-45). Workarounds: 1) try routing to us-east (region param), 2) retry after 30s. ETA 1–2 hours. If you need guaranteed ordering please reply and we'll prioritize.
Escalation: if you see duplicate invoices or charge discrepancies, include "billing" and we'll route to payments immediately.
``` 
jade: added the macro to the shared library, tag is `eu_embeddings_degraded_v1`. Please don't edit in-place — clone if you change wording.
rory: I pushed a tiny change to the CS ticket flow to include the `eu_embeddings_degraded_v1` macro automatically when region==eu-west. Test log looks fine.
tom: small ask — can we get a one-line summary for the status page? Ops wants a short blurb for the public incidents feed.
jade: Draft for status page: "We’re investigating intermittent embedding generation failures in eu-west. Some requests may see errors or degraded results. Mitigation: route to us-east or retry after 30s. Updates every 30m." OK to post?
anita: LGTM. add note to avoid calling out internal ticket IDs publicly (use INC-2026-45 only if necessary).
rory: I'll post at :00 and :30. Also adding a watch to TKT-7382 for oncall.
jade: quick heads-up on volume: please prioritize any tickets with "duplicate charge" or "incorrect refund" in subject — escalate to billing. If you hit an ambiguous one, ping #support-escalations.
tom: doing a pass on open PRs this afternoon, will ping eng-runtime for the tokenizer fix review (small patch). If reviewers are slow, let me know and I can pair-review.
anita: reminder — macro cleanup this week. If you have local copies named like `eu_embed_v1_draft` please move to personal folder; we want canonical names in the library.
jade: thanks everyone. tiny checklist for handoff: rory take billing P1, tom backup, anita keep CS macros, I'll coordinate external comms. Post any major changes here — otherwise I’ll post a noon update. :wave:
